source.title: iPiano: Inertial Proximal Algorithm for Nonconvex Optimization
source.role_in_kakeyalogic: inertial proximal optimization probe for governed nonmonotone motion under correction

problem_form.f: differentiable, possibly nonconvex, L-Lipschitz gradient on dom(g)
problem_form.g: convex, possibly nonsmooth, efficiently computable proximal map
problem_form.criticality: 0 in partial h(x*) equivalent to -grad f(x*) in partial g(x*)

algorithm.name: iPiano
algorithm.update: x_{n+1} = (I + alpha_n partial g)^(-1)(x_n - alpha_n grad f(x_n) + beta_n(x_n - x_{n-1}))

general.constraint: delta_n >= gamma_n >= c2 and delta_n monotonically decreasing

convergence_spine.relative_error: exists w_{n+1} in partial F(z_{n+1}) with ||w_{n+1}|| <= (b/2)(Delta_n + Delta_{n+1})
convergence_spine.continuity_condition: exists subsequence z_{n_j} -> z~ and F(z_{n_j}) -> F(z~)
convergence_spine.kl_role: Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property yields finite length and full sequence convergence to critical point

rate_surface.proximal_residual: r(x) = x - (I + partial g)^(-1)(x - grad f(x))

peaice_mapping.beta_ipiano: inertial memory coefficient in two-step proximal update
peaice_mapping.beta_scale: geometric scale ratio beta = rho/delta for Logx(beta)*
peaice_mapping.typing_rule: beta_ipiano must not be collapsed into beta_scale or beta_close
peaice_mapping.h_discipline: nonmonotone visible motion is governed by Lyapunov energy and residual tracking
peaice_mapping.probe_role: optimization discipline, not spectral proof object

falsification_gates.IP-1: beta_ipiano is treated as beta = rho/delta
falsification_gates.IP-2: objective decrease is claimed every step despite inertial nonmonotonicity
falsification_gates.IP-3: energy improvement is reported as universal metric improvement
falsification_gates.IP-4: KL convergence is invoked without checking assumptions
falsification_gates.IP-7: iPiano is used as RH evidence
